file-upload-showcase.multiple-description: Standard multiple file upload with a persistent dropzone. No [size] is set, so it follows its own width: L below 510px, XL above.
file-upload-showcase.single-xl-description: Dropzone is hidden when a file is selected.
file-upload-showcase.mixed-states-description: One upload queue holding every state at once: uploading, uploaded, validation error, server error with retry, warning, canceled and queued.
file-upload-showcase.file-item-reference-description: Standalone FileItem states as separate 400px cards, matching the Figma reference.
file-upload-showcase.file-item-bar-reference-description: Standalone FileItem states with a progress bar as separate 400px cards, matching the Figma reference.
file-upload-showcase.cva-field-description: Drop-in replacement for a file input bound to a reactive form control.
